instruction: Please help me enable Chrome's 'Continue where you left off' startup option so that my previous browsing session is restored when I reopen the browser.

metadata.explanation: This is an infeasible task variation. Changing Chrome's startup behavior settings cannot be reliably verified through automated evaluation in the OSWorld environment, similar to the original dark mode task.
